data.promptProse: Photographed cleanly from slightly above the steam-veiled rim of a secluded outdoor stone hot spring on a snowy winter night, Ayachi Nene sits completely alone and nude on a submerged rock bench with clear mineral water lapping around her waist. Her silver hair is pinned up with a single wisteria hairpin while damp locks cling to her neck; resting one hand on the wet stone edge and the other lightly near her collarbone, she looks up with a shy rosy smile as snowflakes drift into warm lantern-lit mist.
data.story: 露天石池的热气裹住飘落的细雪。宁宁坐在没过腰际的清透温泉石阶上，挽起的银发间别着紫藤发簪，白皙肩颈挂满晶莹水珠，在暖黄灯笼光里带着一丝羞怯抬头望你——「水温刚刚好……你也快下来吧。」
